title: DewCue At work | Practical Chrome Reminder Ideas

description: Turn “I should study later” into one useful next step. Set a reminder for a specific chapter, revision task, or assignment check. When you sit down, give that task a time window and decide what progress you want to make before the timer ends.

description: Client work comes with decisions to chase, proposals to revisit, and small promises to keep. Give each next step a reminder, then keep the context in a client or project bucket. When you return, you can see what you were waiting for and choose a useful action.
